title: Manual Nanotrap Concentration and RNA Extraction for SARS-CoV-2 Viral Capture
author: Matthew Cavallo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b2uzqex6
materials: In a separate 1.7 mL tube, add 560 µL of Buffer AVL Qiagen Catalog #19073 and 5.6 µL of Carrier RNA Thermo Fisher Catalog #4382878 . Mix well by pipetting up and down several times.

steps.title: Prepare 1X PBS Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1X PBS solution for use in the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Mix 80 g NaCl, 2 g KCl, 14.4 g Na2HPO4, and 2.4 g KH2PO4 in 800 mL Ddwater to create a 10X PBS solution.
Adjust the solution to pH 7.4 using 5% NaOH and/or 5% HCl, swirling and using a pH probe (washed with DI water between uses) until the target pH is reached.
Add double distilled water (ddH2O) until the final volume is 1000 mL.
Dilute the 10X PBS to 1X by adding 100 mL of 10X PBS to 900 mL distilled water.
Dispense the mixture into aliquots and autoclave for 00:20:00; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare Wastewater Sample
steps.instruction: Prepare the wastewater sample for viral capture in a biosafety cabinet.

substeps.instruction: Place a 50 mL conical tube in a tube rack.
Vigorously shake the sample to re-suspend solids.
Add 50 mL of wastewater to the conical tube inside the biosafety cabinet.
Transfer 40 mL of the top supernatant into a new conical tube.

steps.title: Viral Capture with Nanotrap Particles
steps.instruction: Capture SARS-CoV-2 viral particles using Nanotrap Magnetic Virus Particles.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL of BRSV to the conical tube.
Add 400 µL of Nanotrap Magnetic Virus Particles (10) (Ceres Nano Catalog #44202) to the sample.
Invert the tube 2-3 times to mix and create a 10:1 sample volume to particle ratio.
Invert samples 3-4 times every 5 minutes at room temperature for 00:20:00.

steps.title: Isolate and Wash Nanotrap Particles
steps.instruction: Separate and wash the magnetic particles to concentrate the viral load.

substeps.instruction: Place the tube in a magnetic rack for at least 00:10:00 to separate particles.
Use a pipette to discard the supernatant, ensuring the red pellet of Nanotrap particles is not disturbed.
Add 1 mL of Molecular Grade Water (ATCC Catalog #60-2450) to the conical tube and vortex to re-suspend the pellet.
Transfer the liquid to a 1.7 mL tube and place on a magnetic rack for 00:02:00 until the red pellet congregates to the side.

steps.title: Lysis and Particle Separation
steps.instruction: Lyse the captured virus and separate the lysate from the particles.

substeps.instruction: Add 140 µL of 1X PBS to the particle pellet.
In a non-magnetic rack, add Buffer AVL and carrier RNA to the pellet.
Suspend the pellet by using the pipette to wash the sides of the tube with the lysis buffer, carrier RNA, and 1X PBS mixture.
Incubate the sample at room temperature for 00:10:00.
Use a magnetic rack to separate the particles for 00:02:00.
Transfer the supernatant to a 1.7 mL tube and discard the pellet.

steps.title: RNA Purification via QIAamp Column
steps.instruction: Purify the RNA using a QIAamp Mini column.

substeps.instruction: Add 560 µL of 96% Ethanol (P212121 Catalog #BE-BDH1156) to the sample and mix well by pipetting up and down several times.
Add 630 µL of the sample mix onto a QIAamp Mini column; repeat until all sample has passed through the column.
Add 500 µL of Buffer AW1 (Qiagen Catalog #19081), centrifuge at full speed for 00:01:00, and discard the filtrate.
Add 500 µL of Buffer AW2 (Qiagen Catalog #19072), centrifuge at full speed for 00:03:00, and discard the filtrate.
Transfer the QIAamp Mini Column into a new collection tube and centrifuge at full speed for 00:01:00 to remove Buffer AW2 carryover; discard the old tube.
Transfer the QIAamp Mini Column into a final labeled tube and discard the previous collection tube.

steps.title: RNA Elution and Storage
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA and store for downstream analysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 60 µL of Buffer AVE (Qiagen Catalog #1020953) to the QIAamp Mini Column and incubate at room temperature for 00:03:00.
Centrifuge the sample at 16,000 rpm for 00:02:00.
Separate the sample into at least two aliquots.
Store aliquots in a -80 °C freezer until ready for PCR.
